name: Nori (Seaweed)
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated for SIBO as it's low FODMAP and may provide beneficial minerals. Start with small amounts as some people are sensitive to high iodine content.
preparationTips: Use as sushi wrapper or crumble over rice dishes
Toast lightly for enhanced flavor and crispness
Store in airtight container to maintain crispness
Rinse briefly if very salty varieties are used
nutritionalHighlights: rich in minerals like iron and calcium
